notes.title: New Update Available
notes.content:
Hello community

Hard Helmets have a new update ready, after several months of work, the final version of Hard Helmets is near and the new version of early access has many improvements to try.

Hard Helmets received a total change of 100% of their graphic style, which allows a greater fluidity in the computers of low level and superiors. In addition to the minimum system requirements are now lower.

MINIMUM:
OS: Windows XP, Vista, Windows 7 , Windows 8, Windows 10
Processor: Intel i3 or AMD equivalent
Memory: 4 GB RAM
Graphics: ATI or Nvidia Videocard with at least 256MB, or Intel GMA 950 or newer
DirectX: Version 9.0
Storage: 5 GB available space



The new war bonds are ready to be discovered, and from the Bonds Collector menu you will be able to know each one of the characteristics and abilities, as well as to know what war bonds you need to unlock.

The characters have new animations, more fluid and the response time of the controls is much faster.

The Hard Helmets development team has worked hard in recent months so that you can enjoy this game, we hope you continue to comment and collaborate on the development of helmets, we are in the final stages of its development and we will soon launch the final version of the game . steam game

Thank you community and do not forget to continue commenting and reporting errors that can be found in the game

We love

we are waiting for you on the battlefield

notes.title: Ranks & Levels
notes.content:
Hello Community!

This time we would like to talk about the ranks in [b]Hard Helmets[/b].

[b]Hard Helmets[/b] is a videogame where as we advance and get more abilities, we will find harder enemies to defeat.

At the beginning, our load bar is a bit slower which causes that we cannot deploy unit too fast, but, with the time, and as we go increasing our level by capturing flags, destrying enemy's facilities, winning battles and new war bonds. Our level will be increased, achieving that our load bar will be filling much faster and will enable us to deploy units with a lot of speed.

It is not just that, all our units will gain additional power as our rank increases.

notes.title: Know your Warbonds: Infantry
notes.content:
Hi Community!

During a battle in [b]Hard Helmets[/b] it is very important to know how to combine the warbonds depending on your strategy. Remember you can only carry 10 to each battle.

This time we will introduce you Infantry Bond:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/357abd9148fe328bdfdc2ac0c61ab8eb7bbd6924.jpg[/img]

Infantry warbond is an attack unit that will support you attack strategy by being deployed faster and a normal firepower.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/07dbd04fefc5435d152e9dcf7c01f67162ee4201.png[/img]

This unit will go to the front pursuing three main objectives:

[list]
    [*] Attack enemy's units
    [*] Capture the flag on our behalf on neutral bases.
    [*] Destroy enemy's facilities
[/list]

[b]Infantry Units[/b] are helpful when planning a battle with a lot  of men in the field. You can also combine it with other warbonds we will be presenting in the upcoming posts.


Enjoy!!. We are hearing your comments.

notes.title: Guide on Weapons
notes.content:
Hi Community !!!!

[b]Hard Helmets[/b] is a game where as you keep increasing you level, the battles will become more difficult. It is very important to know some of the available weapons you can use to guide and support your men during the battle.

[h1][b]Hand Granade[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/d5eb58f5f6bd544ea5e270dd19fec9d05d864e3d.png[/img]

Generates an explotion when there are many enemies around. Be careful or you can hurt yourself.

[h1][b]Rifle[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/dceedf40a17c2ee165b21543faafd3186547a360.png[/img]

Basic weapon every soldier must know, fast to deploy with a basic firepower.

[h1][b]Submachine gun[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/c93238d90c1b9f8f3f461dc6644b57c6c3f68e31.png[/img]

If the battle get more complicated, how about shooting faster?. More ammunition will be required using this great weapon.

[h1][b]Shotgun[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/d409228d307f4d4c3ef96bbc80c2173675b1971d.png[/img]

Getting serious??. The awesome firepower of this shotgun is all you need. Great Power, but slow to reload. You decide.

[h1][b]Machine gun[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/9285c7128da8c263e6b928145eddae26e83b62f1.png[/img]

Time to deploy a great attack. This machinegun is all you need to face many enemies at the same time. Excellent firepower, Fast firing, Faster reloads.

[h1][b]Sniper Rifle[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/a4df91e487b05587c4c1086366f11b6570c60c17.png[/img]

Give you enemies a surprise they don't expect. A precise head shot is al you need to know them down. Breathe carefully or you'll fail the shot!!.


[h1][b]Rocket Launcher[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/e7fcc3f46a7e99c8886b81c48f41b4c6452f43bc.png[/img]

This beautiful tool will help you to take down easily that heavy armory in the battle, altought is very powerful, it is also hard to control.

[h1][b]Firethrower[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/09fd867c36097b364969c2da26cb1962d8a4119d.png[/img]

Melt everything that's on your way. The firethrower is a powerful weapon that will give you the advantage. Its ignition may take a while.

[h1]Remember !!![/h1]

To use any of this weapons, first you'll have to obtain its war bond, and then equip it to be carried to the battle.

If you carry several weapons, you can switch them using the [b]L[/b] key in the keyboard.

You can only carry 10 warbonds on each battle, so if you carry too many weapons, you will be mostly alone. If you carry none, your default gun and knife can't do really too much in a crowded battle.

notes.title: Know your War Bonds
notes.content:
Hi Community!,

Today we are introducing the types of War Bonds that can be used during a battle. 

War bonds are key in [b]Hard Helmets[/b] to set the strategy to win depending on the battle and the type of enemy you will be facing.

There are 4 principal kinds of war bonds:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/f5a2e2243dacb91c6bc9d6b0ee21fba0fccfe6ec.jpg[/img]

This will deploy several kinds of units that will only perform defense tasks. For example Defend you facilities from enemies.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/f98078769e9b0152ffe1acaad7afddcb9632ce88.jpg[/img]

This will deploy several kinds of units that will only perform attack tasks. For example attack your enemies, capture flags, or destroy enemy's facilities.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/3154b1b1322947e70faf841c86970a8186cfde45.jpg[/img]

This will deploy several kinds of units that will only perform strong attack tasks. Here a little bit of more firepower will be used.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/1b72415ba568811b417375fdffd9e0d76f4738e4.jpg[/img]

In the field you are not alone. This type of war bond will deploy a special attack. In case some support is required. Beware that deploying this will take longer leaving you exposed for some time.

Remeber you can only carry 10 war bonds to a battle. Choose with care depending on your strategy.

notes.title: Captain Mustache
notes.content:
Hi Community,

This time we would like to introduce to you to [b]Captain Mustache[/b], who will be our guide in the field. He will be guiding us to develop the best strategy to win the battle.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/4c4d1ae5d095d1062c876efa4c55724eaff41949.png[/img]

[b]Captain Mustache[/b] is an experienced soldier with a very clean record. He has participated in tactical operations of high complexity and is a big expert in special operations strategies. 

Our Captain is a specialist in the direction of ground units for assault operations and a great expert in heavy weaponry.

Altough he is very strict, he is also very skillful when his support is required to teach us some of his secrets in Hard Helmets. [b]¡A real leader and an example to follow!!!![/b]

notes.title: How controllers work? 2/2
notes.content:
Hello Community!

Knowing the basics of [b]Hard Helmets[/b] is key to improve our abilities, this time, here is a general description on how controls work with a keyboard.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32582023/8cb2918f9936867410dc8228fe532a612f03c11b.png[/img]

[b]Control[/b]: Use Ctrl Key to crouch. It will be more difficult for enemies to hit you.
[b]Space[/b]: Use Space key to Jump. Maybe to avoid some obstacles or to help you to escape from being defeated.
[b]R[/b]: R Key Reloads your weapon. Always be ready to respond to any attack.
[b]G[/b]: G Key throws a granade (If you have any). If some additional fire power is required.
[b]L[/b]: L Key to switch your weapon. Release all your power against your enemies.

Soon you'll know how controls work when using a controller.

Have Fun. We love to hear your comments !!!

notes.title: Update V1.2
notes.content:
Based on the comments of the community, we have worked the last week focusing on solving important problems of control and movement of the player characters, as they had strange behavior and late response control.
Those errors are now eliminated, the control now works in a more immediate and intuitive way.
In the course of this week will also include a new attack card for flamethrower and bombardment from the air

On the other hand we want to inform you that we are working on a next update that will include two new factions, and will also add the faction selection option before each game.
We thank all the players that have shown interest in Hard Helmets, and we remind you again that you can report any errors or let us know any suggestions or ideas to improve Hard Helmets, we are always attentive to the comments of the community and it is our goal to improve the I play with your help.
